from impacket import smbserver

log_filename = "log.txt"
if len(sys.argv) >= 2:
    log_filename = sys.argv[1]
port = 445

    port = int(sys.argv[2])

server = smbserver.SimpleSMBServer(listenAddress="0.0.0.0", listenPort=port)

        server.removeShare(share)
